name: open_memory
title: Open In-Memory Data Source
description: Creates a new in-memory data source from agent-supplied bytes and selects it. Lets you pipe a carved buffer straight into the full ImHex toolchain (patterns, disassembly, hashing, YARA) without writing it to disk first.

data.description: The bytes to load, encoded per the 'encoding' parameter

read_only.description: Whether the in-memory data source should be read-only

handle.description: Handle of the new in-memory data source
